markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (68%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Reliability is low (40%) [F6] and the 90% set holds three classes [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 68%, Benign 16%, InSitu 12% | Leading, not decisive |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu, Invasive | Three classes not separable |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.40 / 90th percentile | Flagged; atypical image |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Invasive | Neighbors mostly InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept association with invasive carcinoma [F2] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 6, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Linked to lower invasive likelihood; low-risk regions · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 1, 3) · ↑ invasive · Smaller association; same regions as stromal invasion · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 0, 1, 2) · ↑ invasive · Score high but failed spot check (0/20); not a reason [F3] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0, so concepts are not shown to reflect the classifier; mitoses (0/20) is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Input flagged as suspect (reliability 40%), so every score may be off.
- Four of five similar cases are InSitu; this may be in situ rather than invasive.

## Check on the slide
1. **0, 1, 3** — Confirm stromal invasion and pleomorphism in these top-scoring regions.
2. **5** — Intermediate invasive score (65%); check in situ versus invasive. Duct-confined concept is weak.
3. **0, 1, 2** — Mitoses scored high but unreliable; count mitotic figures directly.
